steps.code:
# Retrieve all phone contacts and all current venmo friends, paginating.
def get_all_contacts(token):
    contacts = []
    page = 0
    while True:
        res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        contacts.extend(res)
        if len(res) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    return contacts

def get_all_friends(token):
    friends = []
    page = 0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        friends.extend(res)
        if len(res) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    return friends

contacts = get_all_contacts(phone_token)
friends = get_all_friends(venmo_token)
print('contacts count', len(contacts))
print('friends count', len(friends))
print(contacts[:3])
print(friends[:3])
